critique: The dark violet-black background and blue/violet luminous particles create an appropriate mystical palette. Both frames show a clearly circular, rotating/sweeping particle formation, so animation is evident. However, the portal still reads primarily as a sparse dotted circle rather than a strong, continuous glowing annulus. The edge dust is not visually distinct from the ring itself: most particles sit on the same circular path, with too little dense core-versus-loose-debris separation.

suggestions.why: A substantially denser primary emission trail will fill the remaining gaps and establish a readable luminous annulus beneath the dust.
Keep the live aliased particles-per-second control matched so the ring core becomes consistently dense.
Slightly larger primary particles will merge into a brighter, more continuous portal rim instead of isolated dots.
Make the secondary particles visibly finer than the ring core so they read as shed magical dust rather than the portal outline.
